title: Decision: committer fails on invalid stored AppDataUpdate
description: RFC 9420 §12.4: a committer SHOULD include valid proposals 'as long as this results in a valid proposal list'. Readings: (a) drop invalid/conflicting stored proposals and commit the rest; (b) refuse to commit while an invalid one is held. Chosen (Mark): (b). protocol-06 §3.5 has the hub force cached proposals into the next Commit, so dropping one only gets the Commit refused. The hub refuses §4.7-invalid standalone proposals on arrival instead. mimi-mls documents the SHOULD deviation with a comment citing this bead.
